notes: Style V2 Cinder graft: palettes_v2.json ash/obsidian/basalt and salmon lava. Custom soot shades #101017 #16151d #1a1923 #24232d preserve C mock dark values. Cold stone and burned wood share the mineral ramp; copper is weathered, not gold. All pixels are authored at native scale; lava/fire alone carry emissive heat. Row 0: three ash ground fills (base #363340) that tile seamlessly in any mix. Other rows are transparent decals for the code-painted ground: no outlines, place them anywhere on ash. Lava banks and cliffs are painted in code by the region builder, so there are no bank tiles. Multi-frame rows are variants to pick from, not animations.
